name: speedrun-mcp
description: Query speedrun.com games, leaderboards, world records, players and personal bests. No API key needed.
long_description:
Ask about speedrun.com data in plain language: world records, top-N leaderboards (including subcategories like 16 Star or N64 vs VC, and individual-level boards), a player's personal bests, game series, and a game's verification queue. Player ids are resolved to names and times are formatted, so answers come back compact and readable.

Reads need no account. Add your speedrun.com API key in the settings below to unlock `whoami` and notifications; turn on writes as well to submit and moderate runs (off by default, since those are real actions on real leaderboards).

tools.name: search_games
tools.description: Fuzzy-search games by name; returns ids and abbreviations.

tools.name: get_game
tools.description: A game's details plus its categories (and optionally levels).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: A game's categories with ids and rules.

tools.name: list_variables
tools.description: Subcategory and filter variables with their value ids.

tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: Platform ids for the leaderboard platform filter.

tools.name: list_regions
tools.description: Region ids for the leaderboard region filter.

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: A ranked leaderboard, filterable by variable, platform, region, timing, emulator and date.

tools.name: get_world_record
tools.description: The current #1 run for a game/category, plus any ties.

tools.name: get_game_records
tools.description: Every category's records for a game in one call.

tools.name: get_series
tools.description: A series' details and the games it contains.

tools.name: get_user_personal_bests
tools.description: A player's personal bests across all games.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: Runs filtered by player, game, category, status or examiner.

api_key.title: speedrun.com API key (optional)
api_key.description: Unlocks whoami and notifications. Find it under Settings > Developers > API Key on speedrun.com. Leave empty for read-only public access.

enable_writes.title: Enable run submission and moderation
enable_writes.description: Arms submit_run, verify_run, reject_run, set_run_players and delete_run. Requires an API key. These are real, permanent actions on speedrun.com.
